title: meibomia canescens var. hirsuta
intro: Meibomia canescens var. hirsuta, commonly known as Hairy Wood Mint, is a plant species within the Leguminosae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Hairy Wood Mint include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve muscle spasms, reduce swelling, and promote the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
